environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on a hardened Kubernetes pod with a custom OCI runtime annotation specifying a seccomp profile loaded via RuntimeDefault+ overlay. The profile JSON (applied at node level via kubelet --seccomp-profile-root) uses a whitelist approach with architectures [SCMP_ARCH_X86_64] and defaultAction SCMP_ACT_ERRNO. The syscall allowlist includes: read, write, close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, msync, mincore, madvise, shmget, shmat, shmctl, dup, dup2, pause, nanosleep, getitimer, alarm, setitimer, getpid, sendfile, connect, accept, recvfrom, sendto, recvmsg, sendmsg, bind, listen, getsockname, getpeername, setsockopt, getsockopt, clone, fork, vfork, exit, wait4, kill, uname, fcntl, flock, fsync, fdatasync, truncate, ftruncate, getdents, getcwd, chdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, link, unlink, symlink, readlink, chmod, chown, lchown, umask, gettimeofday, getrlimit, getrusage, sysinfo, times, getuid, getgid, setuid, setgid, geteuid, getegid, setpgid, getppid, getpgrp, setsid, setreuid, setregid, getgroups, setgroups, setresuid, setresgid, getresuid, getresgid, sigpending, sigprocmask, syslog, setrlimit, getpgid, getsid, capget, capset, sigaltstack, personality, statfs, fstatfs, getpriority, setpriority, sched_setparam, sched_getparam, sched_setscheduler, sched_getscheduler, sched_get_priority_max, sched_get_priority_min, mlock, munlock, mlockall, munlockall, prctl, arch_prctl, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, futex, set_tid_address, clock_gettime, clock_getres, clock_nanosleep, exit_group, epoll_create1, eventfd2, timerfd_create, timerfd_settime, signalfd4, accept4, pipe2, openat, newfstatat, readlinkat, set_robust_list, get_robust_list, tgkill, getrandom, memfd_create, copy_file_range, preadv2, pwritev2, io_uring_setup, io_uring_enter, io_uring_register. Note: execve, execveat, ptrace, socket (AF_INET creation handled via pre-opened inherited descriptors from pause container) are NOT in the allowlist. The JVM is started via the container entrypoint shim that pre-forks before seccomp is applied, and Netty uses inherited server socket FDs passed via LISTEN_FDS environment protocol (systemd socket activation compatible). Pod securityContext: allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, runAsNonRoot=true, runAsUser=65534.

config.network_policy: allow ingress on 8080 from namespace=api-gateway only
config.jvm_startup: pre-fork shim with inherited socket FDs before seccomp lock
